title: SurveyWeave: An Agentic Framework for Automated Survey Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Surveys help researchers keep up with fast-moving fields, but they take weeks to months to write. Automated survey generation (AutoSurvey) can alleviate this situation, but it is challenging to draw on hundreds to thousands of precisely scoped papers, choose among many valid structures, and stay faithful to its sources while offering insights. We present SurveyWeave, an agentic architecture that decomposes the problem into four tasks coordinated by three agents, each reviewing others' work and conducting revisions based on feedback. We also introduce WeaveEval, a five-dimension evaluation grounded in prior surveys. A comprehensive comparison shows that SurveyWeave outperforms Codex by 8 points and the strongest AutoSurvey baseline by 6 points.

translated_title: SurveyWeave：一种用于自动化综述生成的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 综述可以帮助研究人员跟上快速发展的研究领域，但撰写一篇综述往往需要数周甚至数月的时间。自动化综述生成（AutoSurvey）可以缓解这一状况，然而要在数百至数千篇精确界定范围的论文基础上进行写作、在众多合理结构中做出选择，并在忠实于原始文献的同时提供洞见，仍然充满挑战。我们提出了SurveyWeave，这是一种智能体架构，它将问题分解为四个任务，由三个智能体协同完成，每个智能体都会审查其他智能体的工作，并根据反馈进行修订。我们还引入了WeaveEval，这是一个基于已有综述、涵盖五个维度的评估体系。全面的对比实验表明，SurveyWeave比Codex高出8分，比最强的AutoSurvey基线高出6分。
tldr: SurveyWeave是一种将自动化综述生成分解为四项任务、由三个智能体相互审查并基于反馈修订的智能体框架，并配套提出五维度评估体系WeaveEval，其性能比Codex高出8分、比最强AutoSurvey基线高出6分。
en_tdlr: SurveyWeave is an agentic framework that decomposes automated survey generation into four tasks coordinated by three mutually-reviewing agents, paired with a five-dimension evaluation (WeaveEval), outperforming Codex by 8 points and the strongest AutoSurvey baseline by 6 points.
